_comment: The GitHub issue forms ErgoptiPlus opens (Debug > Report a bug, Suggest a feature). `file` names a form of .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/ and every id in `fields` must be one of its fields (tools/test/test-issue-templates.cjs); `fields` also declares the URL builder's field order and truncation order. Diagnostic reporters prefill only host-derived version, os and driver values. `report_field` identifies the editable attachment field; the complete reviewed report is copied and saved locally, never inserted into the URL. The repository comes from _shared/modules/updater/defaults.json, never from here. max_url_bytes bounds the percent-encoded URL. Built by _shared/ui/issue_link.js and its Lua and AHK ports.
